citation_records.title: Total Mutual-Visibility in Graphs with Emphasis on Lexicographic and Cartesian Products
citation_records.reason: Pairwise EXISTENCE of a shortest path for every vertex pair; Lemmas4.2-4.3 and Theorem4.4/proof optimize total mutual visibility in uniform lexicographic products. Neither ALL Steiner trees nor varying terminal arity; no transport of maximum upper bound.

citation_records.title: The general position achievement game played on graphs
citation_records.reason: Achievement game winner under alternating GP moves, including uniform product winner parity; no Steiner-arity extremum.

citation_records.title: On the General Position Numbers of Maximal Outerplane Graphs
citation_records.reason: Publisher abstract defines ordinary GP and classifies maximal outerplane graphs with gp=3 and extremal bounds. Restricted graph class, no Steiner arity.

citation_records.title: On monophonic position sets in graphs
citation_records.reason: Retained 2012.10330v4 definitions, Lemma3.1 and Theorem5.1 proof: monophonic versus geodesic maxima, not sgp arities. P4 separates monophonic maximum2 from sgp3>=3.

citation_records.title: On the general position number of Mycielskian graphs
citation_records.reason: Definitions and introductory scope: Mycielskian GP bounds; shadow vertices do not carry an all-optimal-Steiner avoidance theorem. No identified same-object maximum comparison.

citation_records.title: On the general position number of the k -th power graphs
citation_records.reason: Graph powers change edges for pairwise GP, rather than terminal arity in one fixed graph.

citation_records.title: The iteration time and the general position number in graph convexities
citation_records.reason: 2305.00467v5 definitions and Theorem6.3 proof reused; general convexity GP/twin kernelization for P3 dissociation, no all-set maximum sgp3 bound.

citation_records.title: The general position avoidance game and hardness of general position games
citation_records.reason: Actual arXiv abstract: avoidance/achievement game hardness and winner, ordinary pairwise GP.

citation_records.title: Lower general position sets in graphs
citation_records.reason: Theorem6.1/proof pp15-16 inspected: unequal clique blow-ups of C6 and Z(w,r,s) compare MINIMUM maximal GP with MINIMUM maximal monophonic sets. True twin saturation uses maximality; cannot assert independent fiber saturation for maximum 3-sgp. No missing bridge supplied.

citation_records.title: The average Steiner (3,2) -eccentricity of trees
citation_records.reason: No abstract in retained OpenAlex, Crossref or Semantic Scholar. DOI resolves to linking page only; primary abstract HTTP403. Tree-eccentricity title suggests a different invariant but is not body evidence; classification remains unresolved.

citation_records.title: The equidistant dimension of graphs: NP-completeness and the case of lexicographic product graphs
citation_records.reason: Distance-equalizer minimum cardinality xi, including lexicographic products; witnesses equidistant to outside pairs, not Steiner avoidance.

citation_records.title: General Position Sets, Colinear Sets, and Sierpiński Product Graphs
citation_records.reason: Definitions, Theorem4.2 proof and Corollary4.3 inspected: Sierpinski product GP and colinear sets; convex fibers give pairwise isometric-cover bounds. gpS here denotes a Sierpinski extremum, not Steiner sgp_k.

citation_records.title: The general position number under vertex and edge removal
citation_records.reason: Definition and Proposition3.2/proof plus theorem inventory inspected: GP under vertex/edge removal. Independent neighbors at distance2 give a lower bound; no maximum sgp3 upper bound or change of terminal arity.

citation_records.title: Graphs Whose Edge General Position Number is 4
citation_records.reason: Publisher abstract quantifies selected EDGES on shortest paths and classifies edge-GP number4. No vertex Steiner maximum.

citation_records.title: THREE ALGORITHMIC APPROACHES TO THE GENERAL POSITION PROBLEM
citation_records.reason: Three algorithms for largest ordinary GP set, pairwise shortest-path predicate. No arity result claimed in actual abstract.

citation_records.title: On the computational complexity of the Steiner $k$-eccentricity
citation_records.reason: Steiner eccentricity maximizes distance over terminal sets containing a fixed vertex, not size of a set avoiding all Steiner intermediates. Algorithms on block/general graphs, no same-object comparison.

citation_records.title: General Position Problem of Butterfly Derived Architectures
citation_records.reason: Publisher abstract solves ordinary GP number for augmented/enhanced butterfly architectures; no arity claim.

citation_records.title: Mutual d-visibility in Graphs
citation_records.reason: Mutual d-visibility uses EXISTENTIAL pair paths conditional on distance threshold d; d is not number of Steiner terminals. No direct implication for ALL-tree maximum.

citation_records.title: Edge general position in graphs: Graph products, integer linear programming and some applications
citation_records.reason: No abstract in retained OpenAlex, Crossref or Semantic Scholar. DOI landing page only; primary abstract403. Edge/product title cannot clear possible general substitution lemmas without actual abstract/body.
